title: Closing the interview
summary: The interviewer asks if Paul has anything to add; he says he could talk until morning but there is nothing more.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Is there anything else that you want to add before we turn the machine off?
Well, there is nothing else. I could talk from here until tomorrow morning, but it's nothing else. It's because it has to go to Pins.
Every time we'd be there. Okay, well...
